bullets.text: In Chennai, a 27-year-old man died and his colleague became critical after falling into a septic tank in Pallikaranai due to toxic fumes; the office should monitor drainage safety compliance.
Near Gummidipoondi, a labourer died from toxic gas inhalation while transferring chemicals between container lorries; the office should watch industrial safety protocols.
In Chennai, a 55-year-old woman reported missing four days ago was found dead in a room at the Mylapore MRTS railway station; the office should track the police investigation.
The Madras High Court adjourned cases regarding the construction ban in the one-kilometre radius around the Pallikaranai wetland to November 11; the office should monitor legal developments.
CUMTA proposed detailed project reports for model mobility corridors covering three key road stretches including Taramani Link Road; the office should review the transit plans.

Minister M. Vijay Balaji inspected monsoon preparedness works and inaugurated an animal birth control centre in Athipattu; the office should track seasonal readiness and municipal animal welfare programmes.
The National Green Tribunal termed solid waste management in Avadi corporation inefficient and ordered the civic body to prevent Cooum contamination; the office should oversee compliance.
A lawyer and an inmate were booked at Puzhal Central Prison after ganja was concealed inside a pen refill; the office should watch prison security measures.

NITI Aayog introduced a Data Centre Evaluation Framework requiring states to check power, water, and public value before backing data centres; the office should align state infrastructure policies accordingly.
Jio Platforms announced its initial public offering to raise ₹30,213 crore next week; the office should monitor digital sector market milestones.
The DMK connected actor-turned-politician Vijay's hand gesture to an RSS salute and revived the BJP B-Team charge; the office should watch political reactions.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay launched the ₹3,108.55 crore ring main pipeline project to interlink water sources in Chennai; the office should track water supply implementation.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay inspected flood prevention and monsoon preparedness works at Okkiyam Maduvu near Sholinganallur; the office should support administrative follow-ups.
